page: The OVHcloud c3-32 is a compute-optimized virtual server powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores on an AMD EPYC x86_64 processor running at 2.3 GHz, with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio. The hardware configuration includes 32 GB of system memory, providing 2 GB of RAM per core, alongside 400 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-core capabilities, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance, Geekbench single-core scores, and Geekbench text processing all ranking in the top 25%. Multi-core operations, such as stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and Geekbench multi-core scores, align with average mid-tier expectations. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression also demonstrates strong performance, while memory bandwidth and database operations remain within average parameters.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c3-32 offers dedicated AMD EPYC resources and local NVMe storage, making it a viable option for workloads requiring consistent CPU performance without hyperthreading overhead. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and strong single-thread performance make this server suitable for compute-heavy tasks, text processing, multi-threaded decompression, and moderate web serving or compilation workloads.
